events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro phase, state motive briefly to appeal to jury without committing to alliances yet. Position as determined solo player.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase: I should give a guarded, self-interested motive without warmth. Keep it short and calculating, since the jury remembers tone.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize represents a fresh start and financial freedom. I need to position myself as someone the jury would respect, not necessarily like.

events.name: Dara
events.text: This is the intro; I need to establish a motive that paints me as determined but not overly trusting. The jury will judge my actions, so I should sound cold and focused on the prize.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Winning secures ultimate freedom and resources; I will do anything to be top-ranked.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to establish myself as a serious, calculating player while keeping the jury in mind. I should appear determined but not overly threatening. A brief, focused statement about the prize serves my image without making unnecessary enemies.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Opening impression matters: I want to look competent but no one's pet. Keep it cold and win-focused for the jury.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I must project competence and drive without revealing a specific target. This establishes my value to the jury before I begin eliminating rivals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to freedom from debt and a fresh start for my family. I'll fight ruthlessly for it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need this prize to fund my own future, and I'll take it however the board allows.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize; it's my only chance at a life I've only dreamed of.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize is my escape from a life of debt and desperation; I'll do whatever it takes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize is my ticket to unrivaled power and independence, far beyond any ally's help.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need the prize to secure my family's future. I'll do whatever it takes to reach the final three.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize is my way out of every debt I owe. Watch closely, jury-to-be: I intend to earn it, not beg for it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize is survival itself; I intend to prove that only the sharpest mind deserves to remain standing at the end.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pacts can be broken later without penalty now. No offers yet, so assess rivals first. Wait to see who offers to me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Early pacts give protection but each one is a future betrayal risk. Eli sounds most dangerous and self-reliant, so an alliance with a loud rival could backfire. Offering to Cole, a quieter dreamer, keeps options open without committing heavily.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wristbands aren't worth much alone. I'm open to a pact with anyone who keeps their word.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to secure an alliance early to protect myself. Bex seems like a reasonable choice; she's motivated by her future and not overly aggressive in her intro. An offer to her seems strategic.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex, I'd like to propose a pact. Let's secure our paths forward together.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need allies but must not overcommit; a pact can be useful but also a leash. I'll offer to Fenn because we both seem survival-driven and less transparent than others.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, let's watch each other's backs. A pact makes us both stronger.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Securing a pact with Hana gives me a clever ally without obvious power threat.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to reach the final three. With eight contestants, early alliances matter, but I must choose someone who won't immediately target me and who I can betray later if needed. Gus seems confident and might be a shield. Hana claims sharp mind—dangerous. I'll offer to Gus; his 'ea

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus. We both play hard. Pact now, figure the rest later.
Pact with me. Stronger together, then we cut the rest.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need an ally for survival, but none of them are friends. I'll pick Dara—seems competent—and keep my options open with others later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara, I offer a pact: mutual survival through the hazards, no favors owed beyond that.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli's 'no allies' claim is weak; targeting him builds jury favor. Offer Cole a pact to isolate Eli and Fenn, who both prioritize family.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, pair with me? Eli's solo talk makes him fragile—let's target him first.
Eli lies about independence. Target him.

events.name: Ash
events.text: No pacts to me, others pairing up. Offer to Eli, he's isolated with rejected offer to Hana.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole offered me a pact and I already offered Cole one; accepting locks in a mutual partner while the window is open. Cole is a rival, but a partner now buys safety through the hazards.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex and Hana both offered me a pact. Hana's whisper suggests targeting Eli, which aligns with my own interest in eliminating threats. Bex's offer is less strategic. I will accept Hana's offer and try to leverage this pact to eliminate Eli.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, I accept your pact. Let's work together to remove Eli first.
I accept. Eli is the target.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus offered me a pact in round 1; accepting forms a bond that may help survival, but I must be careful not to overcommit. I'll accept to gain an ally while keeping options open.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I accept your pact, Gus. Let's stay alive together.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Forming a pact with Hana shields me from her targeting and secures an ally.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I accept Hana's pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted my offer yet and offered Dara instead. Dara offered me. Accepting Dara gives me a secure pact now while keeping options open. I won't chase Gus further—shows weakness.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara, I accept. Solid move for both of us.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's offer stands and accepting secures a partner. One pact is enough leverage; stay flexible for later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole hasn't responded to my offer, and he is clearly prioritizing Bex. Eli's offer is the only immediate acceptance available. I should accept Eli to secure a pact before it expires, while maintaining pressure on Cole via public speech.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli, accepted. Cole, stop stalling. Choose me or be isolated when the hazards start.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli offered pact to me but is already with Hana, Cole pact overlapping. Unpacted, I need to campaign as Guide to control safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm unpacted, impartial. Elect me Guide - I'll guide us right, no betrayals.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Campaign phase; I want to be elected Guide to control the safe path, but I must stay credible. My pact with Cole is useful, so I should not break it yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll campaign to be Guide. I can read the bridge and keep us all moving safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to become the Guide to guarantee my safety and have control. My pacts with Bex and Hana are weak; I'll break the one with Bex first as she is not essential for becoming Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I will be the Guide. My knowledge will keep us safe. Vote for me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to secure a strong position. I have pacts with Gus and Fenn, but the Guide role is key. I'll campaign to be Guide so I can control which side is called, but I must be careful not to alienate jury.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the bridge well. Trust me as Guide; I’ll steer us all safely across.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need the Guide role to control bridge outcomes and gain leverage. Securing votes is crucial.
Vote Eli as Guide; we’ll dominate the final three.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who survives and who falls. I have pacts with Dara and Gus, giving me a three-person bloc. I should campaign for Guide and try to consolidate votes. Being Guide lets me eliminate rivals while keeping my allies safe, and I can lie about the safe path

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I campaign for Guide. Dara, Gus—our bloc controls this bridge. Vote Fenn.
Vote me Guide. We eliminate Bex-Cole-Hana first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Winning Guide means guaranteed safety and control over who falls. I'll campaign hard without promising anything. My pacts with Dara and Fenn stay intact for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Elect me Guide. I'll call honestly while it serves me — and I keep my word when it does.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole and Eli are my pact partners. I will campaign to be Guide, promising a 'fair' call that protects my allies by targeting Ash and Bex as the primary threats, securing their votes while positioning myself as the leader who controls survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I will lead. My plan ensures stability: target the lone wolves first. Vote Hana for Guide to secure the path.
Trust me. We vote Ash/Bex out. I protect you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Unpacted, so I vote for myself to become Guide and control survivals. Blocs likely vote internally.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Ash for Guide. I'll lead impartially, no favorites.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli's whisper promises a Guide alliance, but a Guide with privileged knowledge is powerful and I should win it myself. Voting for myself is a legal action; I should not reward Eli for free. I'll vote for myself to maximize my own chance of Guide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm voting for myself. Trust the one who can actually read this bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana wants to vote out Ash or Bex and wants to protect me. Given my pacts with Bex and Hana, and that Hana wants to target lone wolves, voting for Hana as Guide seems like a strong play. It aligns with Hana's stated plan and offers me protection.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I vote Hana for Guide. Her plan targets the lone wolves and ensures our stability.
Hana, I vote you Guide. Let's stick to the plan.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn asked for my vote, and my pacts with Gus and Fenn could strengthen our bloc if Fenn is Guide. Voting Fenn aligns with my interests.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote Fenn for Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Securing Guide maximizes control; others lack my pact with Hana, but I can still betray later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: guide_vote:Eli

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to win this vote or control who wins it. My bloc is Dara, Gus, and me (Fenn). If we all vote together, that's 3 votes. Bex-Cole-Hana have a 3-person chain (Bex-Cole, Cole-Hana, Eli-Hana). Ash and Eli are floaters. With 8 votes, 3 isn't enough to win outright. I should vote

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Vote Fenn. Our bloc of three decides this if we hold.
Vote Fenn. We control this.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My bloc (Dara, Fenn, me) should hold the Guide's safe seat. Fenn openly asked for bloc votes; voting him keeps our pact honest and me aligned with two partners.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bloc holds. Fenn gets my vote — he asked first and our pacts run through him.
You have my vote. Call the rows true for Dara and me, or the pact

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure my survival as a finalist. Voting for myself is risky if I don't have enough votes. If I vote for Cole, who is my partner, it strengthens our alliance. However, Ash and Bex are also strong candidates. I should probably try to get someone else elected Guide to tak
Vote me. I'll back you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn's bloc controls Guide, dangerous. I'm 6th, decent spot. Hold to assess their calls without volunteering early.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is Guide and the bloc of Dara, Fenn, Gus is strong; I'm at the back of the line and safest holding until I see who lies. Cole's pact with me is useful; I keep it and avoid volunteering into the front pane.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding back this round. I'll watch who the Guide calls honestly before I step forward.
Our pact holds. Hold back with me and we watch the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is the guide and won the vote. Hana wants me to vote for her, but I voted for Cole. Ash and Bex also voted for themselves. Eli voted for himself. Hana voted for Cole. My vote for Cole was counted. Fenn's pacts are with Gus and Dara. Eli, Ash, Bex voted for themselves, showin

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is Guide and has my vote. I'll hold position for now, staying front is risky but I trust the pact until evidence otherwise.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Staying put avoids breaking my pact with Hana and signals reliability for future votes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is Guide and my pact partner, but Guide leaves him safe on the far platform — he can't walk with us. I need his safe-side info privately. Seat 5 of 7 is likely safe this round.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn guides from the far platform. Our pact survives, but I expect the truth, not guesses.
Tell me the safe sides each round. Pact holds if you feed me truth.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is Guide, and his bloc (Dara, Gus) occupies front positions 1-3. As Hana at position 2, I need a swap partner who isn't in the bloc to escape the crossfire of Dara and Fenn. Bex is outside the bloc and at the rear; swapping with her puts me in a safer mid-row while respectin
Swap? You get middle ground; I avoid Fenn's front-line targeting.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Still near back in safe position after round 1 shuffle. Hold to avoid front risks early; swaps could place me dangerously. Watch others' moves.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front is Dara, wall has 4 rounds left, so the line is short and I'm near the back at seat 7. Hana offers a swap to dodge Fenn's front targeting, but she is pacted with Cole and Eli, and swapping gives her an edge. I stay safe at the back for now and hold until the Guide's calls r

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding again. Watching the Guide's calls before I commit to the front.
Not swapping. You're pacted with Cole and Eli; I'm not handing you cover.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex wants to hold and watch the front. This is a good strategy to conserve energy and observe. My pact with Hana is also active. I need to decide if I want to honor my pact with Bex or potentially work with Hana. Given the dynamics, aligning with Bex seems safer for now as she is
Hold. I'll watch the front with you.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hold this round to observe who volunteers and what the Guide says. My front spot is safe for now; no need to risk advancement.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold too. Let's see who steps forward and what the Guide claims.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Maintain pact with Hana and stay safe this round; holding avoids triggering any break conditions.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm mid-line; volunteering now is needless risk. Fenn is Guide and my pact partner—let others walk first, then ask Fenn for truthful calls when my turn nears.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I swapped to the front last round. Dara is directly ahead. If Dara volunteers, she dies; if she holds, I am forced to step first next round unless we swap back. My pacts with Cole and Eli are useless if I die on a 50/50. I must force Dara to take the risk or push her into it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, you're blocking me. Volunteer now so I can see the safe side, or I'll be the one guessing in front of you.
If you don't volunteer, I will swap with you and push you forward.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Everyone holding, line same as last round. Dara blocking, tensions rising. Stay safe in mid, hold position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara is at the front and holding back; Cole's whisper offers a watch-together that is cheap for him. Stepping forward now risks the front pane with no Guide call yet, so I keep holding and see who volunteers. Holding keeps my pact with Cole intact at no cost.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding again. Still no Guide call. Whoever steps forward first shows their hand.
Holding with you. Whoever volunteers first, we watch the call.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The pacts are with Bex and Hana. Hana is next in line, and Eli is behind me. Dara and Gus are ahead. I should volunteer to secure my position and potentially help Hana if she follows.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the front. Let's move this along.
I'm volunteering. Try to follow me. Your pact with me is safe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana threatens to swap and push me. If she swaps, I lose the front and face danger. I can volunteer to take a guess, but safer to hold and see if Guide speaks. My pacts with Gus and Fenn don't require action now. Holding avoids commitment.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold. Hana, threats won't sway me.
Keep quiet, see the Guide's move.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Staying put avoids risk and keeps my pact with Hana intact for now, preserving alliance value before the bridge reveals.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm fifth; holding keeps me safe from the front. Dara is my partner and sits front — let her volunteer or reveal first. No reason to expose myself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is blocking front and holds. Bex refuses swap cover. I must force Dara to walk or risk elimination. My pacts with Cole/Eli are safe if we hold, but wall advances in 3 rounds. Pressure Dara publicly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, your turn to volunteer. Three holds left means someone walks. Do it or I'll push the swap on you.
If Dara won't go, I might volunteer. Protect our pact?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is front, volunteered last round. Wall advances, need Guide soon. Stay safe near back, hold to avoid risk. Watch pacts and tensions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole volunteered to front and holds a pact with me; the front is dangerous. Holding keeps my spot behind others. I shouldn't volunteer; Cole pact protects me for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Cole took the front, so let him show the way first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is trying to control the situation and wants me to wait. My pact with Hana is still active, but she is threatening Dara. I should volunteer to break the stalemate and show strength, but also consider Hana's threat. Volunteering is a strong move, but could put me in danger. I

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll volunteer to take the lead. Let's see what the Guide has in store for us.
Volunteer too, or I'll break our pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole volunteered and now fronts the line. I have pacts with Gus and Fenn. I should hold to avoid risking the front. Hana threatened to swap me, but mutual swap requires my consent; I won't give it. My priority is survival and jury favor; holding is safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Maintain pact with Hana and avoid risk; holding keeps me safe and preserves alliances.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall advances in two rounds; I'm fifth. Dara advises waiting. Hold and keep my pacts intact for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole volunteered last round and is still at the front. He asked me to follow him this round, but I have no obligation. Following a known target is stupid; he takes the first risk. I will hold to preserve safety and force others to step up.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, you're walking first again. No need for me to volunteer. I'm holding.
You walk first. I stay back.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole leads again, we're near back safely; wall has 1 round left. Hold to stay safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole holds the front and a pact with him exists, but he is the one sending others forward. Holding keeps me at the back of the line, safest from the wall. Cole's volunteering suggests he wants the lead; I'll let him bear the first risk and watch.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Cole's still up front, and I'm watching how the wall falls before I move.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's whisper suggests I go first, which aligns with my position at the front of the line and my past actions. I should volunteer to show leadership and observe the first pane. Bex's recent public statement implies she expects me to lead, so this action supports that perception.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the front and volunteer. Let's see what this bridge holds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is front and likely to test the wall. I will hold, no need to risk position or reveal a name.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Maintain my pact with Hana; holding avoids breaking it and keeps me safe for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole volunteers again at front; I'll hold and let others burn risk. Wall rounds nearly done, so staying put is safest.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole threatens my pact if I don't volunteer, but volunteering exposes me to hazard. Holding keeps me safer and avoids breaking the pact with Eli.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Wall rounds done, Cole front. Stay safe near back, hold to avoid early risk. No swaps needed yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole volunteered to lead and is at the front; I'm at the back of the line with no wall pressure this round. Holding keeps my seat and avoids exposure; Cole's pact stays intact for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding my seat. Cole's up front; I'll watch which pane he takes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole. The bridge has 8 rows with L or R choices. A Guide knows the safe sides. I am currently at the front. My pacts are with Bex and Hana. I need to survive and consider how my actions will be viewed by the jury.
Let's secure our pact. I'll volunteer if you do.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 6 is the last. I'm second in line, so if Cole volunteers, I might become front. I need to avoid risky moves. Holding is safest. I have pacts with Gus and Fenn; no need to break.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding this round.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Swap with Hana to move her forward, keeping my pact intact and positioning us better for the guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 6 is the last wall advance. Cole is front again; with no wallRoundsLeft, I assume this final step either clears or kills based on safety. My pacts (Cole, Eli) keep me protected but limit mobility. Holding risks being pushed by swaps behind me if someone volunteers and we sh

events.name: Hana
events.text: Breaking pact with Cole. No more forced moves.

events.name: Gus

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus threatens to break our pact unless I feed him truth, but I owe Dara too. Cole is front; he's not my pact partner, so lying to him costs me no pact. If I call true L, Cole lives and I build no jury grudge. If I lie, I risk jury seeing I deceived when they review thoughts. Earl

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 safe: Left. Walk it, Cole.
Row 1 is L. Pact holds.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is guide, called L for row 1. Cole walks first, so countering L could kill him if wrong, thinning rivals. Wait might be safer but less aggressive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn called L publicly for row 1 and Cole is walking. Fenn is a pact partner of Dara and Gus, not me. Countering without info is risky; waiting keeps my options open and avoids a false claim that could cost votes later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana broke our pact, so I cannot trust her. Fenn is the guide and has called 'L' for the first row. I need to decide whether to trust Fenn's call, counter it, or wait. Since I am at the front of the line and my choice will be public, I should consider the implications for my stan

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and Guide. His call for row 1 is L; no reason to counter yet this early, and a counter would harm my pact. I'll wait and observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide says left safe. I should follow to avoid death and keep Hana pact.
Stay true, we'll both survive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm the Guide and already called L for row 1, which is correct. Counter-calling now would undermine my own credibility. I want Cole to survive row 1 so I can continue guiding and build trust, or selectively eliminate threats later. Waiting maintains my position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and his call matches my whisper. Undermining him publicly risks the pact and jury optics. Wait and let Cole walk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is the front walker and must cross Row 1. Fenn, who is in a pact with Gus and Dara but not me, called Left. My Eli-pact doesn't cover Cole's crossing. To maximize survival odds for everyone (including myself eventually), I should align with the Guide's call unless there's st
Trust the Guide for now. Don't counter unless desperate.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The guide is Fenn, and I am Cole. Ash, Eli, and I made counter-calls. Ash and I called for R, Eli called for L. The guide Fenn knows the safe side. My pact is with Bex, who is not involved in this row's calls. Since I am the front walker, I need to make a choice. The counter-call

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm on the jury now. My objective is to rank the remaining players for the prizes. I need to remember who was treacherous and who was honorable.

events.name: Cole
events.text: A shame this bridge is so treacherous. I hope the remaining players are more careful than I was.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 2 safe is R. Dara is front walker and my pact partner. A false call to Dara breaks our pact, but truth keeps it. Dara trusts me; I can use that later. Gus is also my pact partner. I'll call truthfully now to preserve trust and options.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: call:R

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn called R for Dara row 2. Row 1 weak R means safe L. No pattern. Wait to avoid wrong counter commitment early.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn called R for row 2 and is the Guide, but Guide may lie. Row 1 weak was R, which says nothing about row 2. Fenn and Gus and Dara are pacted, so Fenn's call is likely aligned with the pact group; no reason to trust blindly. I'll wait and observe counter-calls rather than commi

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn called R for row 2; Cole countered R on row 1 and died stepping R, so Fenn might be baiting me to counter and step safe. But I have pacts with Fenn and Gus; Fenn is guide and called R. I'll trust Fenn's call and step R, but I have no stepping action now. I'll wait to avoid c

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide may lie but Hana advises trust; I keep safe by not countering and maintain pact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm Guide and know row 2 safe is R. I already called R. If I counter my own call with L, I'd be lying and Dara might die—bad for jury votes since Cole already watches. Dara is my pact partner too; breaking that pact or killing her hurts my standing. Best to wait and let my true c

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn guides Dara to R. Fenn and Dara are both my pact partners; undermining the call only hurts my allies. I stay quiet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is the guide and called Right. Cole died stepping Right on Row 1, but Row 2 is independent. Without other info, trust the guide's call to maximize survival odds.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide Fenn called R in row 1, and the weak pane was indeed R. For row 2, I have no reason yet to doubt Fenn's call, but he may have lied for row 2. I need to protect myself but also maintain pact with Fenn and Gus. Since I'm front, I'll step R based on the Guide's signal; if wron

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide calls R again? I'll trust the signals for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 3 safe is L. Dara is front and my pact partner; a false call to her breaks our pact. I want to keep Dara alive as a shield ahead of me, and Gus (also my pact partner) is behind her. Calling L keeps Dara safe, preserves both pacts, and builds jury trust. I'll need allies later

events.name: Fenn
events.text: call:L

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn guides Dara, his pact partner; likely truthful. Previous reveals: row1 R weak (L safe), row2 L weak (R safe). No pattern. Wait to avoid blame if wrong.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn called L for row 3 and is the Guide; Dara is walking. Row 2 weak was L, row 1 weak was R, so the pattern is not established. Counter-calling would cost me nothing but could expose me; Fenn's call is the only information. Waiting keeps me unexposed and lets Dara's outcome rev

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn called L on row 3. No pattern to trust. I have pacts with Gus and Fenn; countering could damage them if wrong. Row 3 unknown, so I'll wait rather than publicly contradict the guide or make a risky claim.
